articles.title: The 10 Biggest LEGO Sets You Can Buy in 2026
articles.summary: Going by piece count, we take a look at the biggest LEGO sets that are available now, ranging from Rivendell to the Titanic.
articles.body:
LEGO just launched the biggest set – by piece count – in its history. It's a recreation of Antoni Gaudí's Sagrada Familia, the massive, unfinished church in Barcelona that's been under construction for close to 150 years. The piece count? 12060 bricks, including pillars, relief sculptings, and stained glass windows. It's beautiful inside and out. And like its inspiration, it will take a momentous act of persistence and faith to complete it.

When it comes to LEGO sets, high piece counts and high prices often go hand-in-hand. For years, the standard LEGO pricing came out out to approximately 10 cents per brick, which meant a 5,000-piece set would probably cost $500, give or take. But the modern era has made this formula a bit more nuanced. Partnering with a third-party (like Disney , for example) will drive the price higher. And sometimes, the uniformity and commonness of the pieces will make the price lower.

So, even though this list and our list of the Most Expensive LEGO Sets have some significant overlap, it's not identical. Here, in ascending order – as of November 2026 – are the 10 Biggest LEGO Sets You Can Buy, as measured by piece count.

LEGO The Lord of the Rings: Minas Tirith

The above is a quick TL;DR of the list. If you want details about any of the sets, keep on reading.

An uncommonly beautiful build, the Venetian Neighborhood depicts a canal-side community with Old World Charm, including street musicians, a glassblowing workshop, a luxury villa, and a clock tower that operates with the turn of a crank. The set also comes with 17 minifigures depicting everyone from civilians to carnival goers to tourists. This is LEGO at its most engaged and endearing

Scaled down to microfigure proportions, this recreation of Hogwarts Castle is over two feet tall and a little under two feet wide. In September 2026, it will have been eight years since it first launched – an eternity in LEGO land, especially when some sets retire in under two years. It contains 27 microfigures, but the real treat, at least for Potter afficionadoes, are the four full-size minifigures of the Founders: Godric Gryffindor, Helga Hufflepuff, Rowena Ravenclaw, and Salazar Slytherin.

LEGO has also been releasing a much larger Hogwarts Castle build across multiple sets, but that sort of thing is excluded fromt this list.

We reviewed this set after its launch and were impressed with both its sturdiness and its attention to detail. It comes with a tiny, Imperial Star Destroyer, to illustrate how big the Executor is by comparison. This is also the longest LEGO build in history, measuring close to four-and-a-half feet, which beats out the LEGO Titanic by tenths of an inch.

Rivendell is not only one of the biggest LEGO sets for adults ever made. It is one of the best designed and the prettiest, with elven architecture that looks too light and delicate to be real. From the iconic gazebo to the bridge over the River Brunein; from Bilbo's study to the Council of Elrond; there's so many movie references, so many cool little details for the discerning eye. Check out our review and photo gallery of this set.

Pokémon knew how to make a splash with its first wave of sets . This massive model of Venusaur, Charizard, and Blastoise is close to 7000 pieces. There is some scenery and set dressing, but the vast majority of the build is dedicated to making the three Kanto Starters as big and detailed as possible. You can pose them separately, or as a trio for maximum impact. We built this for its launch; check out our review and photo gallery in full.

The Lord of the Rings partnership has produced some of the most elaborate, advanced sets in LEGO history. The first year, it was Rivendell . The second year, it was Barad-dûr . The third year, it was the Shire . And this year, it's Minas Tirith , the capitol city of Gondor. A craggy, sprawling homage, this recreation of the White City is a beautiful centerpiece to any living space, with a microscale exterior and a miniscale interior. It stands two feet tall and includes minifigures of Gandalf the White, Faramir, Denethor, Peregrin Took, Aragorn, Arwen, and four Gondor soldiers.

This thing is massive and heavy; one should not build this set without reinforcing the shelf that it will eventually display it. It's fragile, and it would not survive a fall. The LEGO Death Star is six floors tall and nearly three feet wide. It contains a working elevator to all of its floors, which operates by the turn of a crank. It's an ambitious build, but it's also decadently expensive, costing close to $200-$300 more than the only two sets with higher piece counts. We reviewed and photographed this set in full; check it out here .

The excessive piece count is almost the point of this set. The 'unsinkable' Titanic was the largest ship ever built when White Star Line launched it in 1911. It's best known today for its tragic sinking on its maiden voyage, in which 1,500 people died. But this four-and-half-foot long build remembers Titanic the way she was, with all her first class decadencies in tact. Check out our review and photo gallery .

The Eiffel Tower is composed of 10,001 pieces, which sounds terrifyingly expensive on its face. But it's actually $630 instead of the $1000 that conventional wisdom would dictate. Nearly five feet tall, with observation decks and elevators that run on cables, this is (as of June 2026) the biggest LEGO set by piece count in the company's history, beating even the 9,036-piece Roman Colloseum that retired at the end of 2023.

Antoni Gaudi started construction on La Sagrada Familia in 1882, and it has been under construction ever since – over 140 years of labor and dedication. LEGO La Sagrada Familia has the most pieces of any set in LEGO history – 12060 pieces in all. This massive recreation of the real-life church has 12 bell towers (one for each Apostle) and fascimiles of stained glass. You build it in roughly the same order as the architects did in real life.

It's a whole lot, but it has no smoothed over facades, no build elements that underplay its complexity. It the rare LEGO set that looks like 12000 individual pieces; at least any person who sees this model, in real life, will know the aggravation and effort that you've placed into it.

What's The Best Way To Get LEGO Sets On Discount?

LEGO piece counts and prices often go hand-inhand. So what's the best way to get expensive, big sets for cheaper?

First, join the LEGO Insiders program , which gives you points for every purchase that you make from the LEGO Store. Those points translate into money, which you can use towards the purchase of an expensive LEGO set. There are also select promotions – Star Wars Day, for example –where purchase of certain LEGO sets will garner double the points. So keep an eye out for deals.

Also, check Amazon, Walmart, Target, Barnes & Noble, and other places where LEGO are sold. Extra inventory, especially when a set's about to be retired, can often go for cheap. And these online and brick-and-mortar outlets often have specific days (Amazon Prime Days, for example) that offer deep discounts on sets that would otherwise sell at retail price.

Kevin Wong is a contributing freelancer for IGN, specializing in LEGO. He's also been published in Complex, Engadget, Gamespot, Kotaku, and more. Follow him on Twitter at @kevinjameswong .

Various Hotfixes have dropped for World of Warcraft Forever this month, bringing a handful of fixes and adjustments to improve game performance, balance, and overall stability.

This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of the November 2026 Hotfixes for WoW Forever, including a link to the full Patch Notes.

Druid The Cooldown Manager no longer shows Berserk, and now correctly shows Lacerate when learned. Idol of Ferocity no longer lists Mangle as an ability it discounts. Feral Fixed an issue where Feral Charge (Cat) was not putting the Druid in combat right away. Fixed an issue where Natural Instinct was not applying correctly to Lacerate or Pounce. Fixed an issue where the Pounce Stun debuff was not showing in the enemy debuffs while active.

Hunter Vulgara the Insatiable and the Shrieklings of Zephras should now belong to the correct hunter pet families. Fixed an issue causing Hunters to sometimes aggro enemies from very far away by targeting them.

Arcane Concentration's activation chance now correctly splits across the cast and every bolt (was granting 10% on cast and per bolt).

articles.title: Take-Two Boss Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6 Expectations, GTA Online, and the Decade to Come
articles.summary: IGN interviews Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick 10 days before the biggest release in entertainment history: GTA 6.
articles.body:
10 days out from the release of GTA 6 , Strauss Zelnick tells me he’s feeling “optimistic.” It might be the understatement of the century. Reporting its second quarter fiscal year 2027 results tonight, Take-Two said preorders for Rockstar’s next game are tracking “far in excess” of the company’s initial expectations. “We know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough,” the Rockstar parent company added.

Or, as Zelnick put it to me during a phone interview, “I'm looking forward to the launch.”

GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing any movie or video game before it in terms of sales and money made. There are concerns it might not just crash the PlayStation Store, but jam up the internet, given so many millions across the world are expected to download the whopping 212GB that make up Rockstar’s surefire hit.

Still, GTA 6, like all video games these days, is beset by threats from all sides. The recent explosion in AI-fueled game clones and PS5 jailbreaks has raised the chances of GTA 6 turning up on PC before Rockstar has had a chance to release it officially. But what can Take-Two do about it?

Meanwhile, all eyes are on Rockstar to see what happens after GTA 6 comes out, after its developers recently insisted its next game won’t take another eight years to make . Yes, it really has been eight years since Red Dead Redemption 2 came out.

In the interview below, we touch on all these topics and more, joke about yet another potential GTA 6 delay, and learn that GTA 6 is so popular it might have even caused sales of Take-Two’s own NBA 2K27 to miss expectations .

IGN: Finally, after a decade of development, delays, ups and downs, GTA 6 is coming out. I'm just wondering, Strauss, how does it feel right now?

Strauss Zelnick: Optimistic. I'm looking forward to the launch.

IGN: Normally I'd ask you if you if there was a risk of GTA 6 being delayed. I've had conversations with you in the past that I'm guessing you can be pretty confident this time it's not going to be delayed again.

Strauss Zelnick: It’s not going to be delayed again.

IGN: There's a line in the financials about Rockstar continuing to support GTA Online with new content and ongoing events for its vast community. I'm just curious what impact you forecast GTA 6 having on GTA Online when the game comes out? What are your expectations about GTA Online from next week onwards?

Strauss Zelnick: We intend to keep supporting GTA Online and it has been very successful. It's been very resilient. It has continued to grow over the years, so we feel very good about it.

IGN: There's another line about preorders for GTA 6 tracking far in excess of your expectations, and you say the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough. Do you make any preparations to try and ensure a smooth launch for your customers? Is GTA 6 so big you might actually crash the internet? Do you do anything around that to try and prevent any problems there?

Strauss Zelnick: We are very focused on that and we intend to do the very best we can to have a smooth delivery experience for all of our customers.

Hannah Sage (EVP, Finance and Chief Accounting Officer): And the preload starts tomorrow in an effort to minimize that impact.

IGN: There was a very interesting recent interview of senior Rockstar developers in Bloomberg. They said the foundation was laid for faster development following GTA 6. I was wondering what your expectation is now with Rockstar? Do you believe Rockstar will be able to release more games faster than before? Will you continue to treat Rockstar as you have done with GTA 6, with the budget and giving them the time needed to create the game like this? What's your take?

Strauss Zelnick: I certainly will continue to support all of our labels in their quest to make the best entertainment experiences on earth. And each of our three labels has its own bespoke strategy and approach and I'm supportive of that.

We do think that the nature and velocity of the content we'll see from our iconic franchises, including GTA, will look dramatically different over the next decade. And that's really being driven by our industry leading commitment to releasing the highest quality entertainment, to reaching our players in new ways and in new places and trying to maintain engagement with our consumers post-launch.

IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?

Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.

IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?

Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.

IGN: Your financials mention that NBA 2K27 came in below your forecast. What do you put that down to and how do you improve upon matters?

Strauss Zelnick: I think the key point is that while below our forecast, NBA 2K27 is our second best release of NBA 2K in history. It's an immensely successful title. It sold 4 million units. And in launching more content than ever before for the rest of the year, we have expectations that the title will do even better than it already has done.

I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far. It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.

IGN: There's also a line there about Borderlands 4. It's now sold over 100 million units as a franchise. Congratulations for that. But there's a line about what lies ahead for this series. Is it your belief that Borderlands can meaningfully grow its audience and improve commercially? And if so, from your point of view, how can it achieve that?

Strauss Zelnick: The answer is yes. It is a big hit franchise already and I think there's plenty more to come. I think if you ask the team at Gearbox, they are highly optimistic that there's a lot yet to be done and I do believe that there is a lot yet to be done. I'm very excited going forward about all things Borderlands.

Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: All Magic Bean and Soft Soil Locations - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Welcome to IGN's guide to All Magic Bean Soil Locations. Magic Bean Soil plots are spread all throughout the world of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
articles.body:
Welcome to IGN's guide to All Magic Bean Soil Locations . Magic Bean Soil plots are spread all throughout the world of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake and look like small anthills with an opening at the top. Planting a Magic Bean in the soil as Young Link will cause a Magic Platform to appear in Adult Link's time, leading you to a Reward. There are 10 Magic Bean Soil locations total, and each one also houses a Gold Skulltula that can be freed by releasing a Bug nearby. We have checklists for each of those bug-released Skulltulas as well as checklists for the loot you can get as an adult using the Bean platforms.

See IGN's full guide to Magic Bean Soil below:

First, let's quickly cover how to get Magic Beans. Magic Beans can be purchased from the Bean Seller in Zora River, accessible once you have the Bombs. He sells you 1 Magic Bean at a time, and the price increases by 10 Rupees each time. He sells out after 10 Magic Beans, exactly enough to fill all plots.

Below is a list of all 10 Magic Bean Soil plots. All of these are accessible as Young Link, though the final two require you to become Adult Link first then go back.

Location : Just past the front entrance of Zora River from Hyrule Field. Find it right next to the Bean Seller.

Reward : Access to the high platform in the middle of the Zora River (also accessible by using a Cucco). 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Located behind the Kokiri Forest Item Shop.

Reward : Access to a high platform above the Kokiri Shop that holds a Purple Rupee. 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : From the Lost Woods entrance, go left, then left . The soil is near the entryway.

Reward : Access to a treasure chest on a high platform that has a Purple Rupee inside. 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found in the same room as the Forest Stage grotto. From the Lost Woods entrance, go right, left, right, left, then left . Find the soil on the right side of the room behind the Business Scrub.

Reward : 2 Gold Skulltulas (including one Skulltula using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found under the large tree on the north side of the Graveyard in Kakariko Village (nearest what becomes Dampe's grave as Adult Link).

Reward : 1 Piece of Heart. 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found right next to the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern in Death Mountain.

Location : Found right next to the Lakeside Laboratory in Lake Hylia.

Reward : Access to certain islands in Lake Hylia while the water level is low, and 1 Piece of Heart. 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found on the cliff under the Gerudo Valley bridge. Grab the Cucco, then jump off the right side of the bridge. Float down to the cliff where the Gerudo is tending to her cow. Find the Soil downriver from her.

Reward : 1 Piece of Heart (also accessible without the Magic Bean Plant if you use a Cucco to float here). 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found near the Fire Temple pedestal ( need Bolero of Fire from Adult Link's timeline to reach ).

Reward : 1 Piece of Heart, access to the upper part of the crater where another Heart Piece is if you missed it earlier. 1 Skulltula (using a bug in a bottle).

Location : Found near the entrance to the Spirit Temple ( need Requiem of Spirit from Adult Link's timeline to reach ).

Reward : 2 Gold Skulltulas (one using a bug in a bottle). 1 Piece of Heart.

articles.title: Skydance Games Confirms Layoffs Following Warner Bros.-Paramount Merger
articles.summary: Skydance Games has laid off staff following last month's Warner Bros-Paramount merger.
articles.body:
Skydance Games has laid off staff following last month's Warner Bros-Paramount merger.

Rumblings of a restructuring started when employees from the recently established Paramount Games Studio reported they had been let go earlier today. Skydance confirmed the layoffs in a statement shared with Variety .

"As part of our ongoing efforts to position Skydance Games for long-term growth and success, we are implementing reorganization and operational shifts across a few areas of our business," a Skydance spokesperson said. "We have stepped back and taken some time to consider where we are investing our efforts and have made the difficult decision to scale down some of our projects.

"As a result, there are roles impacted. This is not a reflection of the talent, dedication, or creativity of those affected and we are grateful for their contributions. We are committed to approaching the process with transparency, care and respect for those who are leaving the company."

Paramount Games – which encompasses gaming studios like Skydance Interactive, Skydance New Media, and other Paramount and Skydance entities – was announced this past June. During an interview with IGN at the time , senior vice president, head of creative and production Shawn Kittelsen detailed what was then described as a renewed push into AAA gaming. This included the announcement of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin , as well as games based on projects like Yellowstone, Tulsa King, and Lioness .

Now, many of the people who would have been or were working on projects in its upcoming slate have been laid off. Writer Mallory Dobry , senior concept artist Ameorry Luo , lead VFX artist Michael Parsons , and associate design director David Ballard were just a few of the names impacted by the move, with each taking to LinkedIn to update their work status.

"Skydance just lost a ton of great talent yesterday," lead engineer David Vera said . "I was not affected this time, but so many passionate, hard-working, talented individuals are now competing with thousands of others trying to get their next gig. In this tumultuous climate, it's hard to find great talent and collaborators to help build your next team and game. The Skydance crew wasn't let go because of performance or problematic behaviors. These are all extremely worthy folks who were pushing themselves to the limit to try to make something they could all be proud of."

Insider Gaming reported that at least 30 developers were affected by Skydance layoffs, adding that "it's believed that the real number is higher." The Skydance games layoffs arrive in a post-Warner Bros.-Paramount merger world. The two entertainment giants were given the go-ahead to join under one Skydance banner last month. We've felt the ramifications of that deal in more ways than one today, as DC Studios just announced that James Gunn and Peter Safran would be stepping down as co-chairmen of the company , effective December 1.

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

articles.title: GTA 6 Caused Some Gamers to Hold Off on Buying New Games — Including Take-Two's Own NBA 2K27, Strauss Zelnick Says
articles.summary: The behemoth that is GTA 6 looms large over the video game industry, and it’s so big that it not only caused the September crush of releases, but caused some gamers to hold off on buying new games entirely.
articles.body:
The behemoth that is GTA 6 looms large over the video game industry, and it’s so big that it not only caused the September crush of releases, but caused some gamers to hold off on buying new games.

Reporting its latest financial results, Take-Two, parent company of GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games, said that its own NBA 2K27 had sold 4 million units, which was “below our forecast for the period.”

Take-Two, which owns both 2K and NBA developer Visual Concepts, said that the NBA 2K27 launch window was “unusually busy, with numerous entertainment experiences competing for players’ attention.” In an accompanying interview with IGN , Zelnick expanded on the point, adding that he felt that GTA 6 had an impact also.

“I think the key point is that while below our forecast, NBA 2K27 is our second best release of NBA 2K in history. It's an immensely successful title. It sold 4 million units. And in launching more content than ever before for the rest of the year, we have expectations that the title will do even better than it already has done,” Zelnick began.

“I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far. It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”

GTA 6 is credited with forcing developers and publishers to either bring their releases forward or move them back in an effort to avoid November. The likes of The Blood of Dawn Walker, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Marvel's Wolverine, Control Resonant and others all launched up against each other in September. NBA 2K27 was officially released globally on September 4, 2026.

Based on Zelnick's comments, GTA 6 won't just have affected NBA 2K27 sales, but caused some gamers to skip other games in favor of Rockstar's next, which comes out November 19. It is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time, setting sales and revenue records, so Take-Two will of course be fine for some time to come. Other publishers and developers, though, might be left struggling.

For now, though, during the quarter Take-Two saw revenue of $1.6 billion, which was slightly below its guidance range of $1.62-$1.67 billion. The company said fiscal 2027 will be "an historic year for Take-Two – driven by our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest quality entertainment experiences." It reiterated our Fiscal 2027 outlook for revenue of $8-$8.2 billion.

Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: Happy Mask Shopkeeper - All Happy Mask Sales - The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Happy Mask Shopkeeper is a Thread of Light sidequest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This quest involves buying and selling four different
articles.body:
Happy Mask Shopkeeper is a Thread of Light sidequest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This quest involves buying and selling four different Masks on behalf of the Happy Mask Shop in Castle Town. The reward for this quest is mostly Rupees, but also access to various Masks that change NPC interactions across the game.

See IGN's complete guide to Happy Mask Shopkeeper below.

This Thread of Light can be started after you show Zelda's Letter to the hate guard in Kakariko Village. Better yet, our first sale target is that same NPC, who tips you off to the Happy Mask Shop and asks you if you could get him the Keaton Mask.

Return to Castle Town and the Happy Mask Shop. After speaking to the Happy Mask Shopkeeper and exhausting his dialogue, check out the Keaton Mask which is the only option at this time.

Return to the gate guard in Kakariko Village and he will buy the mask from you for 15 Rupees. Return to the Happy Mask Shop and pay for the mask, 10 Rupees, leaving you with a profit of 5 Rupees.

Next up is the Skull Mask . Speaking to the bearded man outside the Happy Mask Shop will provide a small hint, he says that someone in the forest might like this mask.

Head to the Lost Woods, then immediately go left from the entrance to find Skull Kid. True to his namesake, he wants the Skull Mask. He pays you 10 Rupees for it, which means a net loss of 10 Rupees once you return to the Happy Mask Shopkeeper.

Next check out the Spooky Mask . Speak to the bearded man outside the Shop and he suggests a kid who hangs out in dark and spooky places might enjoy this mask.

Head to the Kakariko Village Graveyard during the day where you will find a young boy stalking the grounds, emulating Dampe. He wants the Spooky Mask, and pays 50 Rupees for it. This nets us a profit of 20 Rupees, meaning we are back in the black overall!

Finally we will check out the Bunny Hood . The bearded man outside the shop suggests you offer it to someone who loves running through the fields.

Exit Castle Town into Hyrule Field and begin wandering around until you see the Running Man.

If you are having trouble, find a high spot to stand on so you can see more of the field (if you wait until night, you can find him sitting by the boulder northwest of Kokiri Forest).

He will freeze in his tracks when he sees you wearing the Bunny Hood. Speak to him and he will buy it from you for a whopping 200 Rupees! Make sure you've got some space in your Wallet.

Return to the Happy Mask Shop and pay 50 Rupees for the Bunny Hood. This completes the sidequest, and your reward is access to four more Masks: the Mask of Truth, Goron Mask, Zora Mask, and Gerudo Mask.

The Mask of Truth is the grand prize here. Wearing it allows you to read the thoughts of NPCs all over the game .

It also allows you to speak to the Gossip Stones, which offer tips and tricks.

Up Next: How to Get the Biggoron Sword - Trading Sidequest

articles.title: New chief minister outlines main issues facing Isle of Man
articles.summary: The chief minister says connectivity and food storage were among his top government priorities.
articles.body:
The chief minister of the Isle of Man has said reliance on imports, risks of transport disruption, and pressure on household finances are among the main challenges facing the new government.

The warning came after recent storms disrupted sea and air connections , and questions over how prepared the island is for more prolonged supply problems.

Chris Thomas outlined plans to strengthen food security and connectivity, but said emergency preparedness was not among his top five priorities.

The chief minister, ard-shirveishagh in Manx, said: "It is a serious issue. We need to improve connectivity through the airport and through Douglas Harbour."

He said ensuring "the firms that bring our supplies to us... can get to the island will be a big focus for this government".

He acknowledged that more needed to be done around emergency planning and public information, adding the government had held workshops on the issue in 2025 and would look to improve communication with residents.

One area of focus was reducing the island's reliance on imported food through greater support for local agriculture, Thomas said.

He said one of his first meetings in the role was with the Manx National Farmers' Union, with discussions focusing on maximising local production and reducing supply risks.

He also highlighted the need to improve storage and warehouse capacity.

Thomas said there was "substantial building going on" on Cooil Road in Braddan, to "optimise the amount of storage we have".

But the island's ability to maintain supplies remained closely linked to the reliability of its transport connections, he said.

He said: "We had the worst possible situation at the end of October where we had some runway lights out on our airport and we had storms at the harbour."

Improvements were needed at the airport, including air traffic control services, to help provide more reliable and affordable routes, he added.

The ard-shirveishagh said sea connectivity was another priority, with the government facing ongoing questions about the Steam Packet's vessels and the suitability of the new vessel for Douglas Harbour.

Thomas said putting more money back into people's pockets would be central to the government's approach, pointing to the increase in personal tax allowances introduced in the February budget.

He argued that creating a "smaller, smarter, more efficient, more effective" government would help reduce pressure on taxpayers while allowing people to retain more of their income.

He also acknowledged the impact of international events on fuel and food prices, and said the government needed to focus on tackling the underlying problems affecting people's lives.

While he encouraged residents to take sensible steps to manage their own risks, he said household stockpiling was not something he wanted to make a major government priority.

articles.title: Chainsaw Man Box Set Drops to Lowest Price of the Year — Less Than $6 Per Volume
articles.body:
Tatsuji Fujimoto may have abruptly published the final chapter of Chainsaw Man earlier this year , but through memes and the ongoing anime adaptation, Denji still lives on in our hearts. I myself read the bulk of Chainsaw Man online, and as someone who did genuinely love the ending, have been waiting for a decent sale to start picking up physical volumes.

Whether you’re already into the series or have been looking for an excuse to pick up something new, it’s worth checking out Amazon’s latest book and manga sale, where the first Chainsaw Man box set has dropped to its lowest price of the year .

Chainsaw Man Box Set Drops to Lowest Price of the Year

Chainsaw Man Box Set: Includes volumes 1-11

The full box set includes the first 11 volumes of Chainsaw Man, collecting all 97 chapters of the Public Safety Arc. Normally priced at $114.99, Amazon’s discount has brought the full collection down to just $63.27 , equivalent to roughly $6 per volume.

The 11 volumes are housed in a box with illustrations dedicated to some of the most prominent characters: Denji, Power, Aki, and Chainsaw Man. Amazon’s version of the box set also comes with a double-sided poster. One side shows young Denji, while the other depicts a psychedelic take on his Chainsaw Man form.

For newcomers, Chainsaw Man follows a destitute and orphaned teenager, Denji, who fights local Devils to make ends meet. One betrayal leads him to death’s door, but some interesting moves by his trusty dog-like companion, Pochita, bring Denji back as a half-Devil himself. Now empowered by his new Chainsaw Man form, Denji is recruited to join an eclectic crew of government-run Devil Hunters.

While Chainsaw Man follows a somewhat traditional shonen structure shaped by increasingly daunting Devil enemies, the narrative goes beyond your usual power scaling. Fujimoto’s work is particularly well-regarded for its genuinely deep and often devastating storylines, which I suppose you can take as a warning.

So far, the anime has covered the first 38 chapters, while the Reze Arc movie covered the next 13. In other words, reading this specific box set will put you ahead of the curve for season 2.

As mentioned, this particular box set covers the Public Safety Arc. The second part of the manga came to a rather abrupt end with Chapter 232 this past March . While many fans expected additional arcs, Fujimoto himself appears happily freed from Chainsaw Man.

MAPPA’s anime adaptation, however, still has some ways to go. The studio is reportedly aiming to release season 2, which adapts the International Assassins Arc, in the Fall 2027 season. We were particularly big fans of season 1, saying it "not only does justice to the source material, but actively adds to it with cinema-inspired visuals" in our 9/10 review .

Otherwise, fans of Fujimoto should look out for a new live action adaptation of the author’s more tender one shot, Look Back, which is getting a limited theatrical release in North American this December .

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 Update Adds Support for eShop Game Gifting, Just in Time for Christmas — but There's a Catch
articles.summary: Nintendo has released an update for the Switch and Switch 2 to support gifting eShop products, but there’s a catch.
articles.body:
Nintendo has released an update for the Switch and Switch 2 to support gifting eShop products, but there’s a catch.

Ver. 23.5.0 adds support for gifting Nintendo eShop products to members in your Nintendo Account family group only (up to eight total). That means you can’t simply gift games to people on your friends list, as other gaming platforms such as Steam do.

But it’s a start! And this being the family friendly Nintendo, it probably shouldn’t come as a surprise to see the company take a baby steps approach to gifting. In the patch notes , below, Nintendo confirmed that the gifting feature will be available after a Nintendo eShop update scheduled for November 17, so it’s not live yet.

Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 Gifting Feature Screenshots

But the English page for the gifting feature is live, and it confirms how it will work. It only includes “eligible” games as well as DLC and upgrade packs. Nintendo itself said some products may not be eligible for digital gifting. Also worth noting, supervised accounts are not able to send digital gifts, and the number of digital gift purchases allowed in a given period is limited.

Here’s the step-by-step guide to Nintendo Switch gifting, per Nintendo:

Visit Nintendo eShop on your device and find the game you’d like to give as a gift.

From the product page, select the Give as a Gift checkbox, then proceed to purchase.

Select the gift recipient from the list of members of your family group. You’ll also be able to select which of their linked systems to send the gift to.

After selecting your gift wrap color and other options, you’ll complete the purchase as usual.

Please note that gifts are sent to your recipient immediately, so be sure you’re ready!

Meanwhile, Ver. 23.5.0 makes “general adjustments and fixes were made to improve the user experience,” but Nintendo didn’t go into specifics.

Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 Ver. 23.5.0 patch notes:

Added the ability to configure accessibility settings during first-time setup. Information on these accessibility settings can be found in Nintendo Switch 2 first-time setup .

Information on these accessibility settings can be found in Nintendo Switch 2 first-time setup .

Added support for an upcoming feature to allow gifting of Nintendo eShop products to a Nintendo Account family group member. This gifting feature will be available after a Nintendo eShop update, scheduled for November 17, 2026.

This gifting feature will be available after a Nintendo eShop update, scheduled for November 17, 2026.

The following updates have been made in Accessibility in System Settings: Added Portuguese (Portugal) to "Text to Speech" languages. Added Portuguese (Portugal) to the GameChat "Convert Text to Speech" languages.

Added Portuguese (Portugal) to "Text to Speech" languages.

Added Portuguese (Portugal) to the GameChat "Convert Text to Speech" languages.

General adjustments and fixes were made to improve the user experience.

articles.title: James Gunn Reportedly Had Big Plans for Multiple Superman Movies and a Potential Justice League Franchise Before DC Studios Exit
articles.summary: James Gunn reportedly had big plans for Superman movies that may have led to the creation of a Justice League franchise, before his shock exit from DC Studios.
articles.body:
James Gunn reportedly had big plans for Superman movies that may have led to the creation of a Justice League franchise, before his shock exit from DC Studios.

Yesterday, Skydance confirmed the departure of DC Studios co-CEOs Gunn and Peter Safran in a reshuffle that sees former Marvel Studios exec Jeremy Latcham take direct control over DC. The change casts doubt on the future of the DC Universe Gunn was only two years into rebooting, with question marks hanging over the planned Batman movie, The Brave and the Bold.

According to The Hollywood Reporter , the pair’s exit was a combination of studio politics (Gunn and Safran had complete control over DC Studios, but Skydance boss David Ellison allegedly had other ideas) the DCU’s box office struggles, and an apparent feeling that Latcham will deliver movies “more in line with Ellison’s broader tastes.”

DC Universe: Every Upcoming Movie and TV Show

What happens to the DCU? THR claimed Gunn had big plans for Superman in particular. With Superman follow-up Man of Tomorrow due out next summer, the writer and director allegedly was in the middle of writing a third Superman movie, and planned to release a new Superman movie every two years before potentially evolving Superman into a Justice League franchise.

Gunn has talked openly about the potential for a superhero teamup movie in his DCU, and teased the overarching villain the likes of Superman, Supergirl, Wonder Woman, and Batman would go up against. Only last month, Gunn said DC Studios was finally getting ready to cast the DCU's Batman . Are those plans now torn up?

Yesterday, Gunn shared a letter with fans that suggested he was happy to be free from the corporate politics that came with being co-CEO of DC Studios, and was looking forward to getting back to filmmaking only. Gunn added he and Safran have “just been engaged on another DC project which I'm writing, and we'll see where it goes after that. And, of course, the characters we set up will live on.”

THR said Skydance was thinking about the box office returns of the DCU so far when making its decision. While everyone knows that this summer’s Supergirl was a disaster, bringing in just $126.4 million worldwide during its theatrical run, Skydance apparently felt Superman’s $618 million box office haul wasn’t enough for pop culture impact status. What sort of figure would have been good enough? $800 million? $1 billion? Clayface, meanwhile, has brought in $109 million so far, which is seen as a success given the body horror movie was relatively cheap to produce. But is Skydance looking for more mainstream appeal from DC films?

Predictably, fans of Zack Snyder’s DCEU have called for the Snyderverse to return , reinstating, for example, Henry Cavill as Superman and continuing where Snyder’s Justice League left off. There is no indication that Skydance will do so, but that hasn’t stopped fans comparing the box office returns of four years of the Snyderverse and four years of Gunn’s DCU.

Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: Real Motors’ Project Ares is a cyberpunk fantasy made real
articles.summary: We ride Real Motors’ Project Ares “Ghost” prototype, an electric motorcycle pairing retrofuturistic styling with serious, smooth power.
articles.body: Electrification has done wonderful things for motorcycle design. By getting rid of the engine and the fuel tank that supports it, designers have the freedom to do whatever they want, and the results have been occasionally brilliant. I’m a big fan of the vaguely retrofuturistic stylings of the Maeving RM2 and the quirky minimalism of BMW’s CE 02, but nothing yet has quite left me so awestruck as Project Ares. This all-electric machine is the first offering from South Carolina-based Real Motors, and it bears a shape that would not look out of place on the streets of Night City, the main setting in Cyberpunk 2077. There’s a little bit of Star Wars in there and maybe even some Wipeout, too, but it’s never derivative. Most importantly, it’s real. Project Ares starts at $20,000 and ships next year in limited volumes, but don’t let its future cafe racer vibe fool you. This doesn’t quite feel like you might expect. [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: Origins CEO and cofounder Trent Dingman tells me that Real Motors started as a challenge between him and Michael Feng (design engineer and the other cofounder) to “build the coolest possible thing, the best design, and show people what we can do.” Project Ares is the first coolest possible thing: an all-electric motorcycle designed and built in Greenville, right in the heart of the battery belt, not far from already-big and still-developing EV players like BMW, Scout Motors, Volvo, and Redwood Materials. The white bike is an early prototype that’s substantially smaller than the bike I rode, Prototype 04, evocatively called “Ghost” thanks to its distinctive fairing. From a distance, it just looks like glossy black, nothing too special. Come closer, though, and you see the translucence. From in the saddle, you can spot the charger’s cooling vanes, situated inside where the tank would normally be. You can follow the bright orange high-voltage lines as they snake through and around the bike’s battery pack. Things aren’t finalized yet, but that pack will be roughly 15 kilowatt-hours, charging at up to 3.3 kilowatts over a standard SAE J1772 charging port on the very top of its “tank.” The pack powers an electric motor officially rated at 101 horsepower and an insane 738 pound-feet of torque. However, that latter figure requires some context. The number Real Motor quotes is the torque measured at the wheel, after being multiplied by the bike’s gearing. Most motorcycles quote actual torque at the engine or motor output shaft. Measured in the same way, the actual output of the Ares’ motor is probably somewhere closer to 200 pound-feet, still putting it among the strongest twisting motorcycles on the planet. Those are substantial numbers, but then the Ares is carrying some substantial weight. [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: Ergonomics While the Ares may look like it was sent from the future, it’s built in a present where we’re still stubbornly waiting for mass-produced solid-state batteries to fully enter reality. That means big batteries like this one weigh a lot. Project Ares has a total weight of 485 pounds. That puts it right in line with Zero Motorcycles’ SR/F, which has similar power output and battery size. However, the Ares is nearly an inch and a half longer than the Zero. From a more traditional sportbike perspective, the Ares weighs nearly 100 pounds more than a Ducati Panigale V4 and has a wheelbase roughly three-quarters of an inch longer. Having only seen it in photos, I didn’t expect that volume. I had in my mind a diminutive cafe racer, the classic style of machine typified by British riders who like to splay themselves over their motorcycle’s tanks as they buzz from one cuppa to another. And that’s definitely the way the Ares is set up. The bars are set low, putting your chest and head down close to that translucent tank. The pegs are likewise up high, delivering maximum clearance for cornering and putting you into that classic posture. But whereas most cafe racers are skinny and svelte, the Ares has a wide saddle hinting at the mass of the machine beneath you. That aggressive geometry plus its weight made for a somewhat wobbly start as I got a feel for things, but I was quickly up to speed. [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: [Image: In the saddle Riding “Ghost” was a refreshingly distraction-free experience. This prototype lacked mirrors, a choice prioritizing aesthetics over safety. But it did free me from worrying about anything behind. With only a minimalist LCD in front, I could focus exclusively on the ride. Project Ares has three speed settings. Dingman warned me before I got in the saddle that the bike had neither traction control nor antilock braking. With that torque figure, theoretically enough to liquefy the rear tire, I started in mode 1, the lightest, to be safe. I didn’t need to worry. While I’ve found some preproduction EVs to be a real handful, with overly aggressive throttles leading to bikes that want to buck you off the back, I immediately felt at home on the Ares. There’s no abrupt lurching forward as you twist the grip, just a smooth application of increasing power. It wasn’t long before I was up to mode 2, then mode 3, then grinning like a fool with the throttle pegged wide open and my chest flat on the tank. Even in its most aggressive, the Ares is easy to manage, with plenty of power to entertain but such a smooth delivery that it never does anything unexpected. What was unexpected was how it turns. Again, I had a vision of a razor-sharp racing machine, but the Ares takes a bit of muscle. Unlike the aforementioned Panigale, which drops onto its side with just a hint of pressure on the handlebars, the Ghost required a strong, sustained push to turn. I wouldn’t call it reluctant as such, but the feeling is more of a cruiser than a sportbike. A cruiser with extremely sporty components, though. The unmarked suspension on my prototype felt plenty good, but buyers can spec top-shelf Öhlins dampers if they like. Brembo brakes are also on offer, meaning that while this bike comes at a premium price, you at least get premium components befitting something named after the son of Zeus. [Image: Practicalities So it’s a heavier, more intentional ride than its cafe racer style and ergos may imply, but the blame for much of that lies in today’s battery technology. Which leads us to perhaps the biggest question of all: range. The Ares spec sheet lists 120 miles in the city on a charge. Frankly, I didn’t come close to that efficiency during my day in the saddle, but don’t hold that against it. It’s still pre-production, after all, and lots could change in the next few months. Also, I spent a good portion of that day with the throttle pinned open, which is not ideal for maximizing longevity. That said, I’ve yet to meet an electric motorcycle that can live up to its range estimates when ridden hard and at speed. I doubt this one will shatter that paradigm. Even so, Project Ares is already fast, fun, and astonishingly good looking. While the world of motorcycling may be evolving, style still counts for a lot. Photography by Tim Stevens / The Verge

articles.title: Wardogs Season 3 Release Date and Details - WARDOGS Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Season 3 of WARDOGS has almost arrived, and is set to bring a new map, alongside a new Limited Mode to play, as well as various balance adjustments, fixes, and
articles.body:
Season 3 of WARDOGS has almost arrived, and is set to bring a new map, alongside a new Limited Mode to play, as well as various balance adjustments, fixes, and anti-cheat improvements.

This page acts as a comprehensive breakdown of everything we know about Season 3 of WARDOGS, including its release date.

Season 3 of WARDOGS is set to go live on November 12, 2026.

The centerpiece of Season 3 is the new map, Sabatulo , which brings both close quarters combat and urban warfare to the game.

Limited Mode is also being introduced, which is a new way to play. These servers will see everyone having to contend with various restrictions, including limited weapon and ammo types, limited gear, and limited vehicle selections. The intent is to create a more purist experience with less vertical power items, and if players enjoy the mode it'll stick around in future Seasons.

Seasons are also being extended to 3 months each , allowing players to progress at a steadier pace more in line with Season 1. It also enables the devs to prepare content at a more consistent cadence.

Finally, Season 3 is naturally expected to bring a wide variety of balance adjustments and general bug fixes to help improve the performance of the game and its gameplay experience. The devs are also cracking down on cheaters and hackers, with widespread bans and a deepening of their anti-cheat systems.

Up Next: Wardogs Season 2 Details and Patch Notes

articles.title: GTA VI will be available on Xbox Cloud Gaming for Xbox One consoles
articles.summary: Rockstar Games is making GTA VI available on Xbox Cloud Gaming at launch. Xbox One consoles will be able to stream the game.
articles.body: Rockstar Games is making Grand Theft Auto VI available on Xbox Cloud Gaming when it launches next week. While you’d normally assume that would mean Grand Theft Auto VI would be available to stream on phones, PCs, the web, Xbox consoles, and even TVs, it appears to be restricted to just Xbox Series X / S and Xbox One consoles. That does mean that anyone with an older Xbox One console can stream Grand Theft Auto VI instead of having to upgrade to a PS5 or Xbox Series S / X console to play. Rockstar notes that Xbox Cloud Gaming will use the Xbox Series S graphics settings to stream to Xbox consoles. Xbox’s own announcement blog post only mentions Xbox Cloud Gaming streaming for Xbox Series X / S and Xbox One owners. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma says the cloud deal for Grand Theft Auto VI is “the first step in our new 10-year strategic partnership with Take-Two.” Sharma also says the game is “the most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store.” Microsoft is also planning to add Grand Theft Auto V, Red Dead Redemption 2, and more to Xbox Cloud Gaming in “the coming months.” What this all means is that Microsoft effectively has an exclusive on streaming Grand Theft Auto VI from the cloud for launch, albeit only to Xbox consoles. [Media: I originally reported last month that Microsoft had secured exclusive Grand Theft Auto VI cloud streaming rights, but Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball revealed on X that Microsoft wouldn’t be streaming Grand Theft Auto VI exclusively. While Microsoft’s contract might not specifically state exclusive, the end result is exclusive cloud gaming on Xbox, for now. Sony may well eventually announce its own cloud streaming plans for the game, but Rockstar Games notes that Grand Theft Auto VI “will also fully support Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.” That’s not cloud streaming, though. I also initially reported that Grand Theft Auto VI would be available to stream on PC, simply because the entire point of Xbox Cloud Gaming is to make games available on Xbox consoles, TVs, PCs, and the web. It’s strange to see a rare exception for Grand Theft Auto VI, but not entirely surprising. Perhaps Microsoft will eventually be able to stream the PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI whenever it launches. Rockstar Games also confirms Grand Theft Auto VI will run at 30fps across PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series S / X consoles. The main advantage of a PS5 Pro is ray-traced shadows and support for PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR). Update, November 10th: Article updated with comments from Xbox.

articles.title: Bungie Tempts New Players With Free Period as PvE Mode and PvP Arena Battles Come to Marathon
articles.summary: PvE is coming to Marathon and Bungie is hoping new players will give it a shot with a free-to-play period at the start of the next Season. It’s called Symbiosis and is landing on December 8.
articles.body:
PvE is coming to Marathon and Bungie is hoping new players will give it a shot with a free-to-play period at the start of the next Season. It’s called Symbiosis and is landing on December 8.

One of the big new changes is an update to Perimeter, giving the early game region a much-needed shake up. Previously, there was no in-between on the map, with matches either a constant meat grinder against other players or completely dead.

The zone update sees the playable zone expanded as alien trees sprout from the landscape. Now there are dark caves leading to a new POI called Reservoir, which features a large main room and catwalks for nasty ambushes. Oh, and there’s a giant crab boss now.

If you bounced off Marathon because of those aforementioned ambushes, Bungie is introducing a new mode just for you: PvE Expeditions. These let you test yourself against the tougher challenges Marathon has to offer (like big crabs) without the added threat of a team murdering you and stealing your stuff as soon as you pull it off.

Rather than taking the Arc Raiders approach and letting players play the normal extraction loop without the threat of other players, it’s seemingly a standalone mode Bungie is calling a “co-op PvE roguelite.” That means metaprogression, in-match upgrades, no two matches the same. From Bungie, it should be good stuff.

The upgrades in the new mode are called Flash Boosts and should let you become a god in an entirely new way each run. Challenges escalate with each layer you break through and scale with your power. Check out the trailer:

Bungie also introduces a new social space for Symbiosis. It’s called Limbo, and it’ll let you hang with your friends and test out kits.

It should be a good place to train with Bishop, the game’s new high-jumping and sword-slashing new Runner Shell. The trailer shows Bishop cutting through a whole gang of bots with his Ultimate.

On top of all this, there are new weapons and gadgets, as well as a new PvP deathmatch mode for people who want to get better at not being murdered in the normal extraction loop. Marathon will be free December 8-15, giving new players a chance to check it out when Symbiosis lands.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk
